stories.title: The Two Sisters
stories.author: Pauline Johnson
stories.trinket: Her own Instax polaroid of The Lions, taped to the photo string
stories.contentNote: A Squamish legend, told to Pauline Johnson by Chief Joe Capilano, 1911. The Squamish name for The Lions is Ch'ích'iyúy Elx̱wíḵn — Twin Sisters.
stories.summary: The Squamish legend of how the twin peaks visible from Vancouver came to be.

stories.title: Sagacious Marcela
stories.author: Filipino folktale, narrated by Lorenzo Licup; collected by Dean S. Fansler
stories.trinket: Hand-carved wooden hairpin from a Vigan market
stories.contentNote: The hairpin echoes the story's signature riddle: a king sends Marcela one bird and demands twelve dishes from it; she sends back a single pin and demands twelve spoons made from it. Two versions of the tale (Pampangan + Tagalog) included in the .md file.
